data.text:
TRAFFIC ADVISORY
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

19 April 2026

FATAL COLLISION AND TANKER FIRE ON N12 NEAR BASSONIA: TOTAL ROAD CLOSURE

The Johannesburg Metropolitan Police Department (JMPD), in collaboration with the City of Johannesburg Emergency Management Services (EMS), is currently responding to an incident involving a gas tanker fire on the N12 Westbound before Comaro Road in Bassonia.

Earlier this morning, a gas tanker was stationary on the N12 Westbound when a light motor vehicle collided with the rear of the tanker, causing a fire.

Regrettably, JMPD can confirm that the driver of the light motor vehicle sustained fatal injuries and was pronounced deceased at the scene.

Due to the volatile nature of the gas cargo and the fire, a total road closure is in place for both the Eastbound and Westbound lanes. The N12 remains a high-risk zone as cooling operations continue.

The closure is expected to last several hours to facilitate firefighting, cooling of the tanker, and subsequent mop-up operations.

Motorists are urged to avoid the area entirely and follow the designated diversion points:

* N12 Westbound (Heading towards Soweto): Traffic is being diverted at the R59 Reading Interchange.

* N12 Eastbound (Heading towards Alberton): Traffic is being diverted at Comaro Road.

To bypass the congestion, consider using these alternative routes:

1. M1 North/South via the Booysens area.

2. R59 through Alberton.

3. Kliprivier Drive as a local bypass through the Southern Suburbs.

4. Comaro Road via Oakdene.

We urge motorists to exercise extreme patience and, if possible, avoid travelling through the southern parts of Johannesburg.

END

Issued by the Johannesburg Metropolitan Police Department Communications Unit #SaferJoburg #JoburgRoadSafety #JHBTraffic

data.text:
BUMANGGA SA POSTE

Sugatan ang 17 pasahero ng isang modern jeep matapos itong bumangga sa poste sa P. Tuazon corner 15th Avenue sa Quezon City.

Nasa 14 sa mga pasahero ang nagtamo ng galos sa kamay, noo, at binti. Tatlo naman ang nagkaroon ng bali sa kamay, bukol, at pamamanhid sa katawan dahil sa tindi ng impact. Walang natamong sugat ang driver.
Dinala sa ospital ang mga biktima.

Sa inisyal na imbestigasyon ng mga pulis, posibleng naka-idlip umano ang driver. Isasailalim siya sa drug test at dadalhin sa traffic sector.

Posible siyang maharap sa reklamong reckless imprudence resulting in damage to property and multiple injuries. | via Dave Abuel
